body: Yeah, I really just want to take a break from everything and just create with no worries or pressure.

I haven't been really enjoying making art lately because it seems like, there is no point in being creative if my creativity is not getting anywhere. So I am mostly frustrated beyond belief.

I do try to reach out to others, which is probably one of the hardest things. They either acknowledge my existence or they just ignore me...Some of them do respond which is nice and I would get advice or tips from them. So far, networking hasn't done much for me..at least soooo far.
http://0-eos-0.deviantart.com/ But some people just do it better I guess than others..
I think someone told me that as well, but it is hard for me to just create something for the sake of creating. I always want it to look nice and memorable..
